name: Sepulcher
summary: The Forsaken hold Sepulcher above Silverpine Forest’s western coast. Once a Lordaeron graveyard and crypt, it now gives the Horde a fortified refuge amid threats across the region.

sections.title: A Sanctum in the Fog
sections.body:
Sepulcher crowns the hills above Lordaeron’s western coast. Beside the western road, its old cemetery and stone crypt now belong to the Forsaken. Since the Third War, they have turned the grounds and ancient vault into a vital outpost.

Danger presses from every side. Feral worgen stalk the south, Scourge remnants wander east, and Kirin Tor wizards watch from Ambermill. For travelers crossing Silverpine, Sepulcher offers shelter, supplies, and a place of command.

faq.q: What was the Sepulcher before the Forsaken moved in?
faq.answer: Before the Third War and Lordaeron’s fall, Sepulcher was a roadside cemetery and stone crypt where local villagers buried their dead.

faq.q: Why is the Sepulcher so vital to the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Sepulcher is the Forsaken’s only fortified hub in Silverpine Forest. From there, scouts and commanders watch for Dalaran mages, Scourge holdouts, and worgen spreading near Shadowfang Keep.

faq.q: Are travelers belonging to other Horde races welcome here?
faq.answer: Yes. Forsaken deathguards, merchants, and apothecaries manage and inhabit the base. It is an official Horde refuge where orcs, trolls, and tauren can rest and trade as they pass through the region.
Hostile forces surround Sepulcher. Scourge roam to the east, the Kirin Tor hold Ambermill to the southeast, and fierce worgen stalk the woods to the south.

angles.text: Sepulcher directs the Forsaken’s struggle to pacify Silverpine Forest. Their operations target lingering Scourge loyalists, Kirin Tor remnants, and feral worgen.
Traveling south from Tirisfal Glades, you find Sepulcher the only reliable Horde refuge, repair stop, and flight hub for miles.
